sources.bowDrag: Her logs' sawn ends meet the water face on: a flat-faced cylinder in axial flow has a drag coefficient of 0.8 to 1.1, a flat disc 1.17 (Hoerner 1965, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3)
sources.sideDrag: Across her she is a wide, shallow section with rounded corners, side ratio 3 to 5 once mirrored at the surface: 1.0 to 1.3 sharp-edged (Delany & Sorensen 1953, NACA TN 3038), less with round logs, lowered again by her finite length (Hoerner 1965, ch. 3)
sources.sweepMetres: Her rower sits by her side, and the blade swept at arm's length works some 0.7 m beyond her 0.95 m half-beam: 1.65 m from her middle
sources.handsAboveWaterMetres: Her logs' tops lie some 0.2 m above the water, and a seated man's shoulders stand about 0.6 m over his seat (NASA-STD-3000, sitting shoulder height of a 50th-percentile man, 0.59 m)
